title: PACE: Policy Augmentation and Compensation With Explicit Disturbance Estimation for Robust Locomotion
abstract: arXiv:2611.27061v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning has made quadrupedal locomotion remarkably robust. To handle unmodeled dynamics and external disturbances, domain randomization is usually employed to make a policy hedge against every condition it might meet. However, maintaining accurate tracking across varying dynamics and generalizing beyond the sampled range remain challenging. Here we show that explicitly estimating the disturbance and feeding the resulting estimation back into both the policy and the controller can relax this compromise. We introduce Policy Augmentation and Compensation with Explicit disturbance estimation (PACE). The framework lumps payload variations, center-of-mass (CoM) shifts, actuator degradation, and external forces into one joint-space disturbance. A nonlinear observer subsequently recovers this disturbance online without requiring joint acceleration measurements. The disturbance estimation provides feedforward torque compensation

translated_title: PACE：基于显式扰动估计的策略增强与补偿实现稳健运动
translated_abstract: 强化学习已经使四足机器人运动具备了显著的鲁棒性。为了应对未建模的动力学和外部扰动，通常采用域随机化，使策略能够对冲其可能遇到的各种条件。然而，在不断变化的动力学条件下保持精确跟踪，以及在采样范围之外进行泛化，仍然具有挑战性。本文展示了显式估计扰动并将估计结果反馈到策略和控制器中，可以缓解这一折中。我们提出了带显式扰动估计的策略增强与补偿框架（PACE）。该框架将负载变化、质心（CoM）偏移、执行器性能退化以及外部作用力统一归结为一个关节空间扰动。随后，非线性观测器在线恢复该扰动，而无需关节加速度测量。该扰动估计提供了前馈力矩补偿。
tldr: PACE框架通过非线性观测器在线显式估计关节空间扰动（涵盖负载变化、质心偏移、执行器退化与外力），并将估计结果反馈到策略和控制器中进行前馈补偿，从而缓解域随机化在跟踪精度与泛化能力之间的折中，提升四足机器人运动的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: PACE explicitly estimates joint-space disturbances (payload variations, CoM shifts, actuator degradation, and external forces) online with a nonlinear observer and feeds the estimation back into both the policy and controller, relaxing the tradeoff of domain randomization for robust quadrupedal locomotion.
